About this property

Sobha Infinia Phase 2 is the new luxury residential Apartment project launched in Koramangala 1st Block just off HSR Layout, South East Bangalore. The residential enclave Sobha Infinia Phase 2 features the very best in SOBHA’s luxury living segment. The project offers spacious 3,4 BHK Apartments with luxurious features. Beautiful landscapes all around Sobha Infinia Phase 2 with plenty of open spaces make it more special & Elite. The builder is guaranteed to bring a quality living experience to the community of Koramangala 1st Block, HSR Layout, East Bangalore with brilliant architecture and an equivalent lifestyle in Sobha Infinia Phase 2. Sobha Infinia Phase 2 Location has excellent connectivity & it is located in a very prime location at the crux of Koramangala 1st Block, HSR Layout just off Agara Lake, Bellandur, and Sarjapur Road. The project is ideally located close to the landmark business hubs of Ecospace, Ecoworld, Bagmane, and more which house 100s of Top IT companies and hubs in Bangalore as well as near existing and upcoming communities & facilities.
